source:
@@U02659@@
That little thing!

@@U02661@@
Take hold of it first and don’t underestimate it.

@@U02663@@
It’s growing in my hand!
It shines, it flashes!

@@U02665@@
Ah, you're beginning to see now what it’s worth?
That key will seek out the right spot,
so follow it down.
It will lead you to the Mothers.

@@U02667@@
(Shuddering.)

@@U02668@@
The Mothers!
Why does it always strike me like a blow?
What is this word I can’t bear to hear?

@@U02670@@
Why should a new word disturb you?
Are you so narrow-minded?
Only comfortable with what you've heard before?
Whatever comes, whatever its sound,
let nothing disturb you.
You're well accustomed now to strange happenings.

@@U02672@@
What do you want of me,
to turn to stone?
That’s not where my salvation lies.
Shuddering awe is the greatest part of Man.
However fiercely the world may seek to stifle it,
once we're stirred profoundly,
were open to the Infinite.

@@U02674@@
Sink down!
translation:
@@U02659@@
那个小东西！

@@U02661@@
首先抓住它，不要低估它。

@@U02663@@
它在我的手上长大！
它闪闪发光，它闪烁！

@@U02665@@
啊，你现在开始明白它的价值了吗？
那把钥匙会找到正确的位置，
所以跟着它往下走。
它会带你去见母亲。

@@U02667@@
（颤抖。）

@@U02668@@
母亲们！
为什么它总是像打击一样打击我？
这个我不忍听的词是什么？

@@U02670@@
为什么一个新词会打扰你？
你心胸就这么狭隘吗？
只对你以前听到过的内容感到满意？
无论发生什么，无论它的声音如何，
不要让任何事情打扰你。
你现在已经习惯了奇怪的事情。

@@U02672@@
你想要我怎样，
变成石头？
那不是我的救赎所在。
令人战栗的敬畏是人类最伟大的部分。
无论世界如何猛烈地试图扼杀它，
一旦我们被深深地感动，
向无限开放。

@@U02674@@
沉下去吧！
